summary.text: Leigh Wambsganss is the Republican candidate for Texas State Senate District 9 in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which she faces incumbent Taylor Rehmet (D).
She advanced from the March 3, 2026 Republican primary, and she lost the January 31, 2026 special general runoff for the same seat to Rehmet, 57.3% to 42.7%.
